hypothesis: The queue-imbalance mechanism survived M2-0.6 as a directional predictor (0.0794 bps at 1000 ms in the rule-conformant population) but its aggressive monetization paid a 4.1011 bps round trip. A passive entry replaces the paid spread with an earned spread, at the cost of two new risks: the order may never reach the front of the queue, and the fills it does get may be adversely selected. This experiment measures both, deterministically, on the same development tape.
mechanism: Top-of-book displayed queue imbalance selects the side of a resting order at the near touch; the order fills only through real queue depletion at that price.
decision_question: Does queue-aware passive execution on the already-owned development tape have enough economic plausibility to justify acquiring modern/PIT-valid data for a real out-of-sample test?
decision_if_positive: PIVOT_SURVIVES_DEVELOPMENT: quantify which modern parameter could move the decision, then request/scope the data acquisition. No profitability claim, no ADVANCE.
decision_if_negative: KILLED: passive monetization of this mechanism is economically dead on available evidence; update DEAD_ENDS.md, the candidate ledger, DECISIONS.md and PROJECT_STATE.md, and assess whether the QIMB mechanism family has enough evidence to stop.

population.primary: the 33 rule-conformant large-tick names of the M2-0.6 single-day proxy (median quoted spread exactly one tick and at least THETA=0.50 of valid observations at one tick)
population.secondary: all 115 replayed names of the M2-0.6 liquidity scope, analysed separately and never mixed into the primary number
population.scope_manifest: M2/data/manifests/passive_scope.json (written deterministically from the frozen M2-0.6 membership artifact)
population.universe_membership: still BLOCKED: this is a single-day proxy, not membership

sampling_rule: one hypothetical order per symbol per second at the frozen M2-0.6 decision instants, 09:30:00-16:00:00, submitted on the same global clock the M2-0 engine used to emit decisions
feature_version: I(t) = (Q_bid - Q_ask) / (Q_bid + Q_ask) at the decision instant, unchanged from M2-0

frozen_model.order_price: join the near touch: best bid for a buy, best ask for a sell
frozen_model.queue_ahead_definition: every displayed order resting at that price level at submission time is ahead; nothing arriving later is. Position is tracked per order reference number through a global arrival sequence, so a later-arriving order can never advance our position, and a cancel-replace (new reference number) moves behind us.
frozen_model.fill_criterion: fill only against executions (E/C) at our price level, in file order, once the displayed quantity ahead is exhausted and the aggressor's executed quantity reaches our position; a fill is bounded by min(executed shares, our remaining size). Orphan executions, executions of orders behind us while quantity is still ahead, and non-displayed trade prints never fill us.
frozen_model.partial_fill_treatment: partial fills accumulate on the same order; the first fill anchors the markout and exit clocks
frozen_model.ttl: 1000 ms primary (the mechanism's own H2 horizon); predeclared diagnostics at 5000 ms and 30000 ms, reported and never selected on
frozen_model.cancellation_policy: none beyond TTL; no signal-based cancel, so no cancel-latency assumption enters the primary result
frozen_model.cancel_latency: NOT_APPLICABLE by policy; fills occur only while the order is resting
frozen_model.markout_anchor: the first fill timestamp, with the mid measured after the execution that filled us
frozen_model.exit_rule: aggressive exit at the prevailing executable quote at fill + horizon: sell at the best bid after a buy fill, buy at the best ask after a sell fill
frozen_model.exit_resolution: the book state at the first message strictly after fill + horizon (the same as-of rule the M2-0 engine uses); the realized lag is reported as exit_lag_mean_ns / exit_lag_max_ns
frozen_model.fee_treatment: one-sided ledger breakdown: the passive entry leg is charged no exchange fee because the frozen ledger contains no add-liquidity item; the aggressive exit leg is charged its remove-liquidity fee, statutory charges and, on the accessible reference path, commission. A verified Nasdaq add-liquidity credit of $0.0018/share (SRC-0203, a 2026 card) is reported as a labelled sensitivity only.

primary_metrics.M2_fill_conditioned_mid_markout: side-signed midpoint move in bps from the fill timestamp, with a block-bootstrap CI over symbol x 30-minute cells
primary_metrics.M3_executable_net_per_filled_share: passive entry, aggressive exit at 1000 ms, net of the structural floor; the accessible path is reported beside it
primary_metrics.M4_expected_value_per_attempt: sum over fills of (net bps x shares) / attempts, i.e. fill probability times per-fill value
primary_metrics.M5_robustness: the same quantities across the declared |I| states and queue-position bands, plus symbol concentration

kill_criteria: K1 QUEUE_NON_IDENTIFIABLE: priority anomalies or orphan executions exceed 1% of fill events, or the model cannot be reconciled on sampled traces -> EXTERNAL_BLOCK, never fabricated fills
K2 FILL_STARVATION: primary fill rate below 1% of attempts
K3 ADVERSE_SELECTION_DOMINANCE: fill-conditioned midpoint markout at 1000 ms is negative and its 95% block-bootstrap CI excludes zero
K4 EXECUTABLE_NET_NEGATIVE: net per filled share at the structural floor is non-positive AND expected value per attempt is non-positive, with the labelled rebate sensitivity failing to flip the sign
K5 ONLY_UNREALISTIC_QUEUE_POSITIONS: positive expected value appears only in the top queue-position band(s) that jointly carry under 5% of attempts
K6 ECONOMIC_SCALE_NEGLIGIBLE: expected value per attempt below $0.01 of executable value at 100 shares, so positive per-fill economics cannot amortise data, connectivity and operational cost
precommitted_decision_rule.verdict_rule: KILLED if K2 or K3 or K4 holds on the primary population, or if K6 holds while K3/K4 also hold on the fixed path; PIVOT_SURVIVES_DEVELOPMENT only if K4 fails to hold (net positive at the structural floor) with a fill rate of at least 1% and positive expected value in at least two declared states; EXTERNAL_BLOCK if K1 holds.
precommitted_decision_rule.decision_order: K1 is evaluated first (identifiability gates everything), then K2, K3, K4, then K5/K6 as scale checks
permitted_post_result_decisions: assign one terminal state and stop
record the measured fill, adverse-selection and executable-economics quantities as durable evidence
update DEAD_ENDS.md, candidate ledger, DECISIONS.md, PROJECT_STATE.md, evidence ledger
scope a modern-data request only if the verdict is PIVOT_SURVIVES_DEVELOPMENT
register a passive-exit or inventory hypothesis as a separate candidate if evidence motivates it (never inside this experiment)
prohibited_post_result_decisions: selecting the best imbalance state, queue-position band, TTL, horizon, size or symbol subset and presenting it as the strategy
adding a passive exit, inventory management or market making to rescue a failed maker-entry result
crediting a maker rebate in the primary result
using Jev/System-One, machine learning or any fitted fill model
claiming any current-market or out-of-sample conclusion
